customer_segment: Retail consumers / individual account holders in Latin America seeking day-to-day banking plus occasional credit products via digital-first experiences (E6, E8, E9, E11).
end_activity: Maintain an ongoing primary financial relationship for daily money movement and periodic borrowing, with issues resolved and account settings managed over time (E6).

activities.activity: Recognize a need for a banking/credit product and become aware of available providers/options
activities.current_provider: Traditional banks’ marketing/branches, word-of-mouth, and digital channels; Nubank may also be part of the awareness set
activities.customer_goal: Know which institutions/products exist and might solve the immediate money management or credit need

activities.activity: Evaluate and choose a provider/product (fees, friction, transparency, convenience)
activities.current_provider: Self (research and comparison) across incumbent banks and digital banks; decision influenced by how bundled banking steps are delivered
activities.customer_goal: Select a provider that minimizes bureaucracy/hidden costs while meeting functional needs

activities.activity: Open the account and complete onboarding (identity/documents, activation, card issuance, initial setup)
activities.current_provider: Incumbent banks via branch visits/paperwork; Nubank via fully digital, branchless onboarding in-app
activities.customer_goal: Get approved and activated quickly with minimal paperwork and no physical visits

activities.activity: Conduct daily transactions (payments, transfers, withdrawals, deposits) and monitor balances/statements
activities.current_provider: Traditional banks’ bundled channels (branch/ATM/digital) and Nubank’s no-fee, real-time digital transactions; ongoing monitoring via account management tools
activities.customer_goal: Move money reliably in real time at low/no fees and keep visibility/control over the account

activities.activity: Apply for, use, and repay credit products (credit card/loan) as needed
activities.current_provider: Traditional banks’ lending processes and Nubank’s transparent, accessible credit products
activities.customer_goal: Access credit without opaque pricing or excessive bureaucracy and manage repayment smoothly

activities.activity: Get help, resolve issues, and adjust account settings; escalate to physical touchpoints if needed
activities.current_provider: Traditional banks’ call centers and in-branch support; Nubank’s 24/7 digital customer service using AI/chatbots
activities.customer_goal: Resolve problems quickly without waiting, repeated handoffs, or needing a branch visit

profile_vs_cvc_conflicts: The company profile emphasizes streamlined onboarding, real-time transactions, transparent credit, and AI-enabled customer service (E8, E9, E10, E11), but the customer value chain also includes upstream awareness and provider/product choice behaviors that are not explicitly addressed in the stated proposition (E6).

The customer value chain includes additional bundled bank activities like cross-selling into insurance/investments and reliance on physical touchpoints for certain complex/unresolved issues (E6), which are not covered in the stated Nubank value proposition and may represent unserved/externally served steps.
